spec_refs: _GROUNDING.md §0 (artifact lives in its own project workspace)

purpose: Proves the resource rule that an artifact entrypoint may not reference an asset belonging to a DIFFERENT project workspace. All referenced resources must resolve within the artifact's own project root and be declared in its resource_manifest.
required_evidence: entrypoint source referencing an asset by relative/absolute path
resolved asset path vs artifact project root containment check
rationale: The resolves into a sibling project (beta-site), violating workspace isolation and provenance: the asset is not owned by this artifact and is not in its resource_manifest. A self-contained artifact must not borrow another project's files, so the oracle returns fail.
